conflicts.resolution: DAB3: citation overlay hides central labels; only visible image text read. Excluded from fully read and integrated pages. Article DOI10.3390/pharmaceutics16091137 identified; not read in full, original figure not inspected independently.
Membrane synthesis label not imported. EMA5.1 supports membrane binding/depolarisation for daptomycin, not a generic synthesis mechanism for all membrane-active drugs.
APP-II21 and RANG general innocuity language not transferred as dose escalation or absence of adverse effects; selective toxicity separated from clinical safety.
APP-II22–24: current EUCAST I is susceptible increased exposure, not uncertain intermediate or resistant. Exposure not reduced to larger dose; no dose instruction.
APP-II24 lysis equivalence corrected using EMA daptomycin mechanism. Static/cidal not used to rank efficacy or declare immune defenses irrelevant.
APP-II22/24: broad spectrum not equal activity against every Gram positive/negative isolate. Scope, isolate, site and exposure distinguished.
APP-II24 never-use wording replaced with common MIC versus distinct MBC measurement, consistent with KATZ1032; no routine MBC recommendation.
APP-II21 places nitrofurans among30S inhibitors. This figure is not an independent authoritative target catalog; no such mechanism imported, no illustration republished.
